title: Do not infer newness or hide conflicting definitions
preconditions: Use newInventoryQueryFixture: known base contains store/reader, head adds system/later, reader has competing heads, one earlier commit has absent Saga and another has unreadable Saga.

steps.action: Query inventory normally and with --intent proposed.
steps.expected_result: Legacy intent stays unspecified and the conflicting reader remains explicitly unresolved even when no proposed records match.

steps.action: Query --new against the unreadable baseline, query the comparison without --new, then request --new without a baseline.
steps.expected_result: Unreadable baseline returns baseline_unknown for the filter and unknown newness otherwise; baseline-free --new returns invalid_argument.

steps.action: Query inventory --feature and inspect scope_paths plus unresolved rows.
steps.expected_result: Only declared feature pins and their members are selected; membership paths identify the System and conflicted members retain scope paths.
